author: bardic-inspiration
name: Dapplehound
summary: A lean, spotted hound that runs the forest in a pack and vanishes at the first patch of sun-flecked shade.
description: Packs of dapplehounds herd travelers toward their dens, never closing for the kill until the prey tires. Their yips carry strangely, so a pack of six can sound like a dozen on every side.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.text: The hound has {ref:glossary/advantage} on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the hound's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the {ref:condition/incapacitated} condition.

traits.name: Dappled Hide
traits.text: While in dim light or among trees, the hound has {ref:glossary/advantage} on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.onHit: and the target has the {ref:condition/prone} condition if it is Medium or smaller.
